title: Manufacturer, packer or importer address carries its locality components
plain: The address is complete enough to reach the company
plain_action: Check the address block gives a company name, a street or locality and a PIN code, and photograph the whole block.

citation.text: The name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer shall be declared. Screening of parsed components only: a name, address wording and a PIN code. This does not certify that the postal address is complete, correct or that the party is reachable.

messages.pass: The address block carries a name, locality wording and a PIN code; postal completeness is not certified.
messages.violation: The declared address is missing a name, locality wording or a PIN code.
messages.inconclusive: The address components could not be read well enough to judge; verify the printed block.

sources.review_status: primary source reviewed; screening paraphrase; incomplete consolidation
